title: %lookup — map a key through a table
purpose: Translate a value via a declared lookup table.
notes: The table is declared with a {$table.NAME[col1, col2]} block above the output section.
The first argument is the quoted "TABLE.column" naming the column to return; remaining arguments are the keys to match.
A key with no matching row resolves to ~ (null).

avoid.why: argument order is "TABLE.column" first then the key; reversing them matches nothing and yields ~
the column reference must include the table name ("BODY_TYPES.code"); a bare column resolves to ~
